Title: Release version 0.1.0

0.1.0

### Changes

The skill `software-life-cycle`: the stages of the life cycle, the processes each stage draws on and the decision gates between them.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Given the catalog installed from `dev`, when the skills of the plugin are listed, then `software-life-cycle` is among them
